meta.title: Grok Subscription
meta.description: Use a SuperGrok or X Premium Grok Build subscription in DeepSeek Harness

en.adapterHint: If this says "unavailable", the host has no pi-ai adapter; check the DSH installation and restart.
en.caveats: Community plugin, not an official product. Using a subscription from an unofficial client may be a vendor-ToS gray area; use your own account only. The protocol can change because official docs do not publish the full HTTP wire protocol.
en.deviceHint: The panel shows a one-time code. If no browser opened, use u201COpen the sign-in pageu201D in the status line and confirm that same code.
en.loginHint: Requests a device code from auth.x.ai on this machine and hands the link to your browser. The panel syncs itself once you authorize. The grok command is not required.
en.loginTimeout: Timed out waiting for authorization; click sign-in again.
en.loginUnreachable: DSH cannot reach auth.x.ai. A browser that opens x.ai does not mean DSH can: DSH ignores the system proxy setting (such as the u201Csystem proxyu201D switch in Clash or v2rayN). Add https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:PORT to ~/.dsh/.env (on Windows, %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.env), using your proxy appu2019s HTTP port (socks5:// is not supported), then quit and restart DSH completely. A proxy appu2019s TUN mode also works.
en.noModels: No models are exposed until you sign in.
en.pullHint: Reads ~/.grok/auth.json securely (refuses symlinks and group/other-readable files). Sign-in and renewal write this file too, and only the short-lived access token is stored in DSH.
en.subtitle: Use a SuperGrok / X Premium (Grok Build) session, not XAI_API_KEY. xB7 2.0.9
en.title: Grok Subscription
en.usageMissingPercent: The upstream API returned no credit percentage for this period.
en.usageOmittedZero: The API omitted a zero percentage, so this shows 0% used and 100% remaining. It is not a separately reported number, and it is not shown unless the billing window contains the current time.
en.usageSubtitle: From the undocumented subscription billing API (/v1/billing?format=credits). Informational only; the endpoint may change or disappear.
en.usageUnifiedBilling: The upstream API returned no credit percentage: this account is on unified billing (measured by prepaid balance and an on-demand cap), so there is no weekly credit reading to show.
en.versionAvailable: A new version v{version} is available.
en.versionCooling: v{version} was published recently. DSHu2019s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update again later.
en.versionCoolingUntil: v{version} was published recently. DSHu2019s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update after {time}.
en.versionFailed: Could not check the latest version.
en.versionLinked: Installed from a local checkout; pull and rebuild the plugin repository to update.
en.versionManual: Run dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-grok-subscription@latest in a terminal to update.
en.versionRestartHint: The plugin cannot safely restart its host process: press Ctrl+C in the terminal running DSH, then run dsh web again.
en.versionUpdatedHint: The new version takes full effect after a DSH restart; refreshing the page alone does not reload the plugin inside the host process.
en.versionUpdateFailed: The update failed. Try again or update manually in a terminal.
en.versionUpToDate: You are on the latest version.
